sources.title: European Accessibility Act (EAA)
sources.why: Mandates consumer mHealth apps meet WCAG accessibility, ensuring users with disabilities are not excluded by the digital divide.

sources.title: Other national reimbursement schemes (Belgium mHealthBelgium, etc.)
sources.why: Reimbursement pathways determine whether patients can afford an app, directly shaping socioeconomic access to digital health.
